BootstrapConfig.title: BootstrapConfig
BootstrapConfig.description: Single lock document confirming the initial system Administrator has been configured.

adminEmail.description: Normalized email of the initial system Administrator.

initializedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who initialized the system.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the database was bootstrapped.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered user profile and role assignment managed by Administrators.

firstName.description: User first name (letters and spaces only).

lastName.description: User last name (letters and spaces only).

managerEmail.description: Normalized email of the assigned Manager (empty if none).

managerName.description: Full name of the assigned Manager (empty if none).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user was last updated.

TimeEntry.title: TimeEntry
TimeEntry.description: Logged work hours entry submitted by an Employee and reviewed by their Manager.

hours.description: Decimal hours worked (minimum 0.5, maximum 24.0, 1 decimal place).

managerEmail.description: Normalized email of the Manager reviewing this entry.

managerName.description: Full name of the reviewing Manager.

employeeEmail.description: Normalized email of the Employee who owns the entry.

employeeName.description: Full name of the Employee who owns the entry.

comments.description: Manager feedback or adjustment request comments.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last modified.

/system/bootstrap.description: Singleton bootstrap lock document indicating initial Administrator creation.

/usersByEmail/{userEmail}.description: Directory of authorized users keyed by normalized lowercase email.

/timeEntries/{entryId}.description: Employee time entries linked to their assigned Manager for review.
